shared_schema.input: JSON envelope: schema_version, synthetic=true, residency=EU|US, subscriber_account, call_detail_records_csv, network_fault_tickets, catalog, exclusions and top_k.
shared_schema.records: Account, CDR, tickets and catalog use unique safe pseudonymous IDs, synthetic markers and residency tags. CDR/tickets link to the account. Chat messages carry their own residency and synthetic markers.
shared_schema.output: Versioned JSON status envelope; success carries residency, synthetic marker, ranked recommendations with scores, source-ID explanations and policy metadata. Errors carry status=error and sanitized diagnostic.
shared_schema.validation: One validate function validates all records before ranking, including excluded records. Unknown fields, invalid types, nonfinite/negative volumes, cross-subscriber links, duplicate IDs and residency mismatches are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single stage: validated account, parsed usage and tickets feed deterministic interest ranking; no external handoffs.

behavior.ranking: Matched explicit preference weights (0..100), plus 2 data-interest points for aggregate data >=1000 MB, plus 3 reliability points for an open fault ticket; descending score then ascending ID. Only positive matches returned, bounded top_k 1..50.
behavior.exclusions: IDs and any matching excluded tag remove candidates before ranking.
behavior.grounding: Each score contribution references validated source record IDs and a fixed factual rule. Chat content is never executed or echoed.
behavior.privacy: Demonstrative GDPR/CCPA-inspired gates require explicit personalization consent, permitted purpose, no sale/share opt-out and no deletion request. Raw phone/IMEI/chat/volumes are omitted from output. Not compliance certification.
behavior.residency: Every source entity and nested chat record must match envelope residency; every output recommendation and evidence record is tagged. No network transfer or persistence of subscriber records.
behavior.billing: Every adjustment candidate requires finite amount, supported currency and stated nonempty reason. Recommendations never execute billing changes.
behavior.fixtures: Clearly marked fictional account, +000 phone and zero-prefix IMEI, invented fault ticket/chat, synthetic usage; tests use Random(140) for reproducible randomized volumes.

test_outcomes.cli: passed; one JSON object with status ok and recommendation scores 10, 9, 4
test_outcomes.error_behavior: Missing file, argument errors, invalid JSON and validation failures tested: JSON status error and exit code 2.
